verses.1: Therefore, by virtue of our faith, we have peace with the Lord through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.2: And by this, we have taken up the responsibility of fulfilling our obligations in accordance with this grace. We will then rejoice in the hope of God’s glory.
verses.3: Not only that, but we should also rejoice in our hardships, knowing that hardship actually fosters patience.
verses.4: But patience is a test, while hope is another test.
verses.5: But hope does not fail us. For the love of God is ignited in our hearts through the Holy Spirit given to us.
verses.6: For Christ, who is among us who are weak, still died at the right time for those who were unfaithful.
verses.7: For once anyone dies out of a sense of justice; for they truly dare to die for what is right.
verses.8: And God has united His own love with us, because Christ died for those of us who are still sinners.
verses.9: Therefore, since we have now been forgiven by his blood, we shall be saved from his wrath.
verses.10: For if we were enemies to God, we would have been destroyed by the death of his son. But if we were reconciled to God through him, then we will be saved in his life.
verses.11: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God because of our Lord Jesus Christ. Through Him, we can now receive this redemption.
verses.12: Therefore, just as one person’s sin entered the world, so too did death through that sin. And in the same way, death entered all people through their sins.
verses.13: For as long as there was law, sin existed in the world. But sin does not cease to exist simply because there is no law anymore.
verses.14: But death ruled over Adam to Moses. It also ruled over those who did not sin in the same way as Adam, who is a model for those who will come in the future.
verses.15: But it’s not just a gift of material things; it’s also a gift of grace. For when many people died because of human actions, God’s grace and gift surpassed all others. This gift was given by Jesus Christ to many people.
verses.16: And it wasn’t given as a gift by one person alone. For the punishment comes from one person to another, while the gift comes from many people to one person.
verses.17: For if death reigns through one person, then those who receive more from the grace and gifts of justice will also reign through one person—that is, through Jesus Christ.
verses.18: Therefore, just as there is one way in which all people can be judged, there is also one way in which all people can be entitled to rights in life.
verses.19: For just as many people were brought down by the sin of one person, so too will many others be brought up by the obedience of one person.
verses.20: A law was therefore enacted in order to reduce the excesses. But when this excess became too much, the grace of God was used to control it.
verses.21: Just as sin reigned in death, so also the grace of God will reign through righteousness for eternal life through Jesus Christ, our Lord.
